projects.title: Student Feedback Website

Clean responsive forms optimized for both mobile and desktop screens
Backend data aggregation with MySQL structured records

Relational schema for student cohorts, sections, and subjects
Admin panel for approving registrations and generating rosters

projects.title: Club Member Management System
projects.tagline: High-efficiency member administration and event tracking system
projects.description: An object-oriented member management system featuring hierarchical access control, dynamic record search, and approval queues.

Fast in-memory data structures for rapid searching and member categorization
Admin approval workflows with persistent file record serialization

Clean tabular views for department coordinators and students
Centralized database schema for semester-long academic terms

projects.title: Football Event Manager

Real-time standings calculation based on wins, draws, and goal differentials
Interactive match day dashboard for fans and event organizers
